verses.modern: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

verses.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.modern: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

verses.kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
verses.modern: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show You the most excellent way.

chapters.summary: Paul teaches that there are diversities of gifts but the same Spirit, and that the Spirit distributes to each one individually as He wills. He uses the human body to illustrate that every member is necessary — the eye cannot say to the hand, "I have no need of you" — and that God has set the members in the body as it pleases Him.

verses.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.modern: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels but have not charity, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

verses.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.modern: If I have the gift of prophecy and can understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have faith that can move mountains, but have not charity, I am nothing.

verses.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.modern: If I give all I possess to the poor and give my body to be burned, but have not charity, I gain nothing.

verses.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.modern: Charity is patient. Charity is kind. It does not envy. It does not boast. It is not proud.

verses.kjv: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.modern: It does not behave rudely. It is not self-seeking. It is not easily angered. It keeps no record of wrongs.

verses.kjv: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verses.modern: It does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth.

verses.kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.modern: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

verses.kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.modern: Charity never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

verses.kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.modern: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

verses.kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.modern: but when the perfect comes, the partial will be done away.

verses.kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.modern: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put childish ways behind me.

verses.kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verses.modern: Now we see through a glass, darkly — but then face to face. Now I know in part; but then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

verses.kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.modern: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and charity. But the greatest of these is charity.

chapters.summary: Paul declares that without charity, all gifts are nothing — tongues, prophecy, knowledge, and even faith that moves mountains amount to nothing without love. Charity suffers long and is kind, does not envy or boast, bears all things and endures all things. Prophecies, tongues, and knowledge will pass away, but faith, hope, and charity abide — and the greatest of these is charity.

verses.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.modern: Pursue charity, and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially prophecy.

verses.kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
verses.modern: For anyone who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God. No one understands him — he utters mysteries in the Spirit.

verses.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.modern: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for their strengthening, encouragement, and comfort.

verses.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.modern: The one who speaks in a tongue builds himself up, but the one who prophesies builds up the church.

verses.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.modern: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would rather have You prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he also interprets, so that the church may be built up.

verses.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.modern: Now, brothers, if I come to You speaking in tongues, what good will I be to You unless I bring some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?

verses.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.modern: Even lifeless instruments, like the flute or harp, must give distinct notes — otherwise how will anyone know what is being played?

verses.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.modern: If the trumpet does not sound a clear call, who will get ready for battle?

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
verses.modern: So it is with You. Unless You speak words that can be understood, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

verses.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
verses.modern: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

verses.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
verses.modern: If then I do not understand the meaning of what someone is saying, I will be a foreigner to the speaker and the speaker will be a foreigner to me.

verses.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
verses.modern: So it is with You. Since You are eager for spiritual gifts, try to excel in those that build up the church.

verses.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.modern: For this reason, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret what He says.

verses.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.modern: If I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

verses.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.modern: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.

verses.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
verses.modern: Otherwise, if You are praising God in the spirit, how can someone who does not understand say "Amen" to your thanksgiving? He does not know what You are saying.

verses.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.modern: You may be giving thanks very well, but the other person is not built up.

verses.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
verses.modern: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of You.

verses.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
verses.modern: But in the church I would rather speak five words with my mind to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

verses.kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
verses.modern: Brothers, do not be childish in Your thinking. Be infants in evil, but in Your thinking be mature.

verses.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.modern: In the law it is written: "With people of strange tongues and other lips I will speak to this people, and even then they will not hear Me, says the Lord."

verses.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.modern: So then tongues are a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not unbelievers.

verses.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.modern: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who do not understand or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that You are out of Your minds?

verses.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.modern: But if an unbeliever or someone who does not understand comes in while everyone is prophesying, He will be convicted by all and judged by all.

verses.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
verses.modern: The secrets of His heart will be revealed. He will fall down and worship God, declaring, "God is truly among You."

verses.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.modern: What then shall we say, brothers? When You come together, each one has a hymn, a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. Everything must be done to build up the church.

verses.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
verses.modern: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two — or at most three — should speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

verses.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.modern: If there is no interpreter, the speaker should keep quiet in the church and speak to Himself and to God.

verses.kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.modern: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

verses.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.modern: And if a revelation comes to someone who is sitting down, the first speaker should stop.

verses.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.modern: For You can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may learn and be encouraged.

verses.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.modern: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the control of prophets.

verses.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.modern: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace — as in all the churches of the saints.

verses.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
verses.modern: Let Your women keep silence in the churches, for it is not permitted to them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also says the law.

verses.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.modern: If they want to inquire about something, they should ask their own husbands at home. It is shameful for a woman to speak in the church.

verses.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.modern: Did the word of God originate with You? Or are You the only people it has reached?

verses.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.modern: If anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, let him acknowledge that what I am writing to You is the Lord's command.

verses.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.modern: If anyone ignores this, he will be ignored.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.modern: Therefore, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

verses.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.modern: But everything should be done in a proper and orderly way.

chapters.summary: Paul teaches that prophecy is greater than tongues in the assembly because it edifies the church, while tongues without interpretation edify only the speaker. He instructs that all things in worship must be done decently and in order, with no more than two or three speaking in tongues, and each in turn with an interpreter.

verses.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
verses.modern: Now, brothers, I want to remind You of the gospel I preached to You, which You received and on which You have taken Your stand.

verses.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
verses.modern: By this gospel You are saved, if You hold firmly to the word I preached to You — otherwise You have believed in vain.

verses.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.modern: For what I received I passed on to You as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures,

verses.kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.modern: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the scriptures,

verses.kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.modern: and that He appeared to Cephas, and then to the Twelve.

verses.kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.modern: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at the same time, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

verses.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.modern: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

verses.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
verses.modern: Last of all He appeared to me also, as to one born out of due time.

verses.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.modern: For I am the least of the apostles, not fit to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

verses.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.modern: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace to me was not without effect. I worked harder than all of them — yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

verses.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.modern: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what You believed.

verses.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.modern: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of You say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

verses.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
verses.modern: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

verses.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
verses.modern: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is useless and so is Your faith.

verses.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.modern: More than that, we are then found to be false witnesses about God, for we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead. But He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.

verses.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
verses.modern: For if the dead are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.

verses.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.modern: And if Christ has not been raised, Your faith is futile; You are still in Your sins.

verses.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
verses.modern: Then also those who have fallen asleep in Christ are lost.

verses.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
verses.modern: If only for this life we have hope in Christ, we are of all people most to be pitied.

verses.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.modern: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

verses.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.modern: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead also comes through a man.

verses.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.modern: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be quickened.

verses.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
verses.modern: But each in His own order: Christ the firstfruits, then at His coming those who belong to Christ.

verses.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.modern: Then comes the end, when He delivers the kingdom to God the Father after destroying every rule and every authority and power.

verses.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.modern: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.

verses.kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.modern: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

verses.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.modern: For He has put everything under His feet. Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, it is clear that this does not include God Himself, who put everything under Christ.

verses.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.modern: When all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subject to the One who put everything under him, so that God may be all in all.

verses.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.modern: Now if there is no resurrection, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

verses.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.modern: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

verses.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.modern: I face death every day — as surely as I boast about You in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
verses.modern: If I fought wild beasts at Ephesus with nothing more than human motives, what have I gained? If the dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."

verses.kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.modern: Do not be misled: "Bad company corrupts good character."

verses.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
verses.modern: Come back to Your senses and stop sinning. Some people are ignorant of God — I say this to Your shame.

verses.kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.modern: But someone will ask, "How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?"

verses.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.modern: How foolish! What You sow does not come to life unless it dies.

verses.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
verses.modern: When You sow, You do not plant the body that will be, but just a seed — perhaps wheat or something else.

verses.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.modern: But God gives it a body as He has determined, and to each kind of seed its own body.

verses.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
verses.modern: Not all flesh is the same: people have one kind, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.

verses.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.modern: There are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the glory of the heavenly bodies is different from that of the earthly bodies.

verses.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.modern: The sun has one kind of glory, the moon another, and the stars another. And star differs from star in glory.

verses.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.modern: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead. What is sown is perishable; what is raised is imperishable.

verses.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.modern: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

verses.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.modern: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

verses.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
verses.modern: So it is written: "The first man Adam became a living soul." The last Adam became a quickening spirit.

verses.kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.modern: The spiritual did not come first, but the natural, and after that the spiritual.

verses.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.modern: The first man was from the earth — earthy. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

verses.kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.modern: As was the man from the earth, so also are those who are of the earth. As is the Man from heaven, so also are those who are of heaven.

verses.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.modern: Just as we have borne the image of the man of earth, we will also bear the image of the Man from heaven.

verses.kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.modern: I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.

verses.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.modern: Listen, I tell you a mystery: we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

verses.kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.modern: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. The trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

verses.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.modern: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

verses.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.modern: So when this corruptible has put on incorruption, and this mortal has put on immortality, then shall come to pass the saying that is written: "Death is swallowed up in victory."

verses.kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
verses.modern: "Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?"

verses.kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.modern: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

verses.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.modern: Therefore, my dear brothers, stand firm. Let nothing move You. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, knowing that Your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

chapters.summary: Paul declares the gospel: that Christ died for our sins, was buried, and rose again the third day according to the scriptures, and appeared to more than five hundred brethren. He argues that if Christ is not risen then faith is vain, but now Christ is risen and become the firstfruits of them that slept. He reveals the mystery that at the last trumpet the dead shall be raised incorruptible and death shall be swallowed up in victory.

verses.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
verses.modern: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I directed the churches of Galatia, so you also are to do.

verses.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.modern: On the first day of every week, each of you is to put something aside and save it up, as he may prosper, so that there will be no collections when I come.

verses.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
verses.modern: When I arrive, I will send those whom you have approved with letters to carry your gift to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.modern: If it seems worth my going also, they will go with me.

verses.kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.modern: I will visit you after passing through Macedonia, for I intend to pass through Macedonia.

verses.kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.modern: Perhaps I will stay with you or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey to wherever I go.

verses.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.modern: I do not want to see you now just in passing. I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

verses.kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.modern: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,

verses.kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.modern: for a wide and effective door has opened to me, and there are many who oppose me.

verses.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.modern: When Timothy comes, see to it that he is at ease among you, for he is doing the work of the Lord just as I am.

verses.kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.modern: So let no one look down on him. Send him on his way in peace so that he may return to me, for I am expecting him with the brothers.

verses.kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.modern: Now regarding our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to visit you with the brothers, but it was not at all his will to come now. He will come when he has opportunity.

verses.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.modern: Watch, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

verses.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.modern: Do everything in charity.

verses.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.modern: You know that the household of Stephanas were the firstfruits of Achaia and that they devoted themselves to the service of the saints. I urge you, brothers—

verses.kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
verses.modern: to submit to such men and to everyone who works and labors with them.

verses.kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.modern: I am glad about the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

verses.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
verses.modern: They refreshed my spirit as well as yours. Give recognition to such men.

verses.kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.modern: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

verses.kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
verses.modern: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

verses.kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
verses.modern: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand.

verses.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
verses.modern: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.modern: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with You.

verses.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.modern: My love be with all of You in Christ Jesus. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul gives instructions for the collection for the saints in Jerusalem, directing each person to set aside something on the first day of the week. He outlines his travel plans, commends Timothy and Apollos to them, and closes with exhortations to watch, stand fast in the faith, and let all things be done with charity.
